The crash came from a typo in `settings.json`. The key was `"rat"` instead of `"rate"`, so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` returned `None`, and `None * 10` raised the `TypeError`.

I renamed the key to `"rate"`. `python3 main.py` now exits cleanly and prints `Total: 5.0`.

I didn't change any code. `get_rate()` still returns `None` silently when the key is missing, so a similar typo would fail the same confusing way. I can make it raise a clear error instead if you want.
